title: Route 9 Small Bay LOI from Example Logistics REIT
summary: Example Logistics REIT offers $14,400,000 for Route 9 Small Bay with a $300,000 deposit and 30-day due diligence.

evidence.quote: This letter of intent is dated November 6, 2026.
The Buyer is Example Logistics REIT.
The Seller is Model Fund I Route 9 LLC.
Buyer will deliver an initial deposit of $300,000 within three business days of a signed purchase agreement.
Buyer shall have a due diligence period of 30 days.
Closing will occur 30 days after the end of the due diligence period.

fields.value: Buyer's obligations are not contingent on financing.

evidence.quote: Buyer's obligations are not contingent on financing.
